integration_issues.issue: React Native Alert.alert on submit blocks the form UI (form remains visible) until user dismisses. On web preview the alert is an in-app modal so page.on('dialog') does not fire and test screenshots capture the form-with-alert state. Same pattern flagged in Iteration 1 for order/collection/retailer. Data IS created on backend (confirmed via API). Consider replacing with toast for smoother mobile UX and easier automation.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' (from react-native-web or a dep). Non-blocking but noisy. Reference: browser console

action_items: (Optional/UX) Replace Alert.alert() success/error confirmations after expense/complaint/order/collection/retailer create with an inline toast or router.replace so form auto-dismisses and web automation is smoother.
(Optional) Silence 'shadow* is deprecated. Use boxShadow' warning by migrating shadow style props (or upstream dependency).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py `_aware_dt` helper is used in attendance_end but similar pattern is also handled inline elsewhere - centralized helper is a good addition, consider using it consistently for any future in-Python datetime comparisons.

server.py POST /api/expenses uses raw datetime and stores IST-based `expense_date` string (`ist_date_str()`) while created_at is UTC. This is intentional but worth documenting; date filters and range partitioning should be aware.
server.py POST /api/admin/products stores product doc but does not enforce non-negative rates/MRP; consider adding validation (Pydantic Field(gt=0)) for MRP.

server.py POST /api/admin/users normalizes employee_id via .upper(); good. But PUT /api/admin/users allows changing role/name/password/active only - it does NOT allow updating employee_id (may be a deliberate choice). Confirm business rule.
Attendance/Expenses/Complaints endpoints in server.py look correct with proper role guards via require_admin(). No security leaks observed (password_hash excluded on all read paths).
